text: Hello everyone, welcome to our English class.I'm Hu Jiawei.Nice to see you again.Boys and girls, do you like making friends?If you have made a new friend and he is visiting your city, what will you ask him?Well, today you are going to learn something about talking with new friends.Before we start our lesson, please make sure you have these things.Your student's book, your notebook, worksheet and pens.请准备好你的课本,笔记本,学习单,和笔。Are you ready?Ok, now let's start.Look at the picture.Who can you see?Alice, Kitty and a girl in the middle.Actually, the girl is called Winnie.Then, what's the relationship between Alice, Kitty and Winnie?Well, please listen and find it out.Can you answer the question?Yes, Winnie is Kitty's cousin.We know that Alice and Kitty are good friends, so Winnie is Alice's new friend.Read these sentences.Where does Winnie live?In the USA.Did she visit Garden City before?No, because she is visiting Garden City for the first time.Here, time means 次数, so the phrase for the first time means 第一次Look at the picture.What are they talking about?Look, what's in Winnie's hand?It's a map.We know that Winnie is visiting Garden City for the first time, so maybe they are talking about where Winnie wants to go in Garden City.Maybe they are talking about how to get to different places in Garden City, or where Winnie has been in Garden City.Now, please listen to the dialogue and find out what they are really talking about.Take out your worksheet.Finish task one.Kitty and Alice are asking Winnie about where she has been in Garden City.Have you been to Ocean Park yet, Winnie?No, I haven't been to Ocean Park yet.Have you been to Garden City Zoo yet?Yes, I've just been to Garden City Zoo.Have you been to North City Park yet?Yes, I've already been there.What about Water World?No, I haven't been there yet.I'm going there on Saturday.Have you got the answer?They are talking about where Winnie has been in Garden City.Then, what question did Kitty and Alice ask to find out where Winnie has been?Listen again and finish task two.What question did they ask?You've got it.Have you been to Blah Blah yet?Here's a new word, yet.It means 上, 还, 仍然.It is an adverb.Please read after me, yet.We usually use yet in general questions.In the dialogue, Kitty and Alice have mentioned four places in Garden City.The first one is Ocean Park.Ocean means 海洋大海.Read after me, ocean.The other three places are Garden City Zoo, North City Park, and Water World.Now, please look at Task 3 on your worksheet.Listen to the dialogue again and find out where Winnie has been and where she hasn't been in Garden City.Tick yes or no in the table.Let's check.Has Winnie been to Ocean Park?What about Garden City Zoo?Has Winnie been to North City Park?Now, please open your student's book and turn to page 11.Please read the dialogue and find out how Winnie tells Alice and Kitty where she hasn't been.When talking about Ocean Park, Winnie says,I haven't been to Ocean Park yet.When talking about Water World, Winnie says,I haven't been there yet.So actually here, she says she hasn't been to Water World yet.Here, haven't been to means 没去过某地。Did you see the word yet at the end of each sentence?Besides in general questions, we also use yet in negative sentences.除了在一般疑问句中,我们还会在否定句中使用yet。Please read the dialogue again and find out how Winnie tells Alice and Kitty where she has been.When talking about Garden City Zoo, Winnie says,I've just been to Garden City Zoo.Here, I've is the short form of I have.When talking about North City Park, Winnie says,I've already been there.So actually here, she says she has already been to North City Park.Both have already been to and have just been to can mean 去过某地。But what do just and already mean?Look at the calendar and guess the meanings of just and already.This is a calendar.What does it mean?It means 日历。Read after me, calendar.According to the calendar, what's the date today?It's September the 13th.Winnie went to Garden City Zoo on September the 12th.Winnie 去 Garden City Zoo 的日期离讲话的日期比较近。So she says,I've just been to Garden City Zoo.Can you guess the meaning of just?It means 刚才,方才。The letter 语 in this word is pronounced as 啊。Read after me, 啊,啊,语,啊,语,啊。Just, just.Winnie went to North City Park on September the 6th.Winnie 去North City Park 的日期离讲话的日期相对远一些。So she says,I've already been there.Here, already means 已经。Read after me, why?AlreadyNow, please complete Winnie's words by using already, just, or yet, according to the calendar.Suppose I'm Winnie now.I have already been to North City Park.I've just been to Garden City Zoo.I haven't been to Waterworld yet.I haven't been to Ocean Park yet.Now, please read the text aloud with the recording.Winnie is visiting Garden City for the first time.Have you been there yet?Here, what about means 做某事怎么样。Now, can you make a dialogue by yourself to talk about where Winnie has been and hasn't been in Garden City?You will have one minute to prepare.I've been to office for a long time.I've been to the station.Have you been to the station?Yes, I have been there.Yes, I have.中文字幕小編,請多多指教!This is the dialogue made by Joanna and Jason.Let's read it together.You can enjoy the interesting dolphin show.Yes, I've just been there.Pandas are so cute.It's really cool to play water games there.Wow, the dialogue is fantastic.Joanna and Jason added a lot of details in their dialogue.For example, they shared personal experiences, gave some suggestions, and talked about something impressive.These details made their dialogue closer to real life.Great job!Boys and girls, let's put what we've learned from them into use.Your friend Nancy is visiting Shanghai for the first time.Look at the calendar and make a dialogue with her to talk about where she has been in Shanghai.Remember to use the question, have you been to, with yet?And the answers, I have been to, I haven't been to, with already, just, or yet, correctly.Try to share personal experiences, give suggestions, and talk about something impressive in your dialogue.You can start.Time is up.This is the dialogue made by Lisa and Mary.Have you been to the bond yet?I'm going there on September the 24th.Remember to take a camera with you.You can take some pictures of the beautiful view.Have you been to People's Square yet?I fed the pigeons at the square.Have you been to Yu Garden yet?I tasted xiao long bao.They are so tasty.Did they use the question, have you been to, with yet?Did they share personal experiences?Did they give any suggestions?Did they talk about anything impressive?Good job, Lisa and Mary.Boys and girls, let's sum up.In today's lesson, you learned how to ask and answer about where your friend has been and hasn't been when he or she is visiting a city.After class, please complete the exercises on your homework sheet.So much for today.See you next time.Bye bye.
